svg.aria-label: Browser: Opens http://localhost:8080 (http://localhost:8080), served by nginx:alpine. It gets index.html, css/main.css and js/index.js (ES modules). Fetch: The module script in index.html calls fetchArticles(). fetch() reads data/articles.json (id, headline, text) as JSON. Buttons: createArticleButtons() builds all buttons in one DocumentFragment: one DOM update for all of them. #overlay: Holds an aside with the article buttons and an article with headline and text. Alle Kategorien opens it. The close button or Escape closes it. Focus, click, hover: Focus or click shows the article at once. Mouseover waits for a 300 ms debounce. ARIA and small screens: aria-hidden and aria-inert follow the overlay and side-menu state. Below 768 px the article list sits behind a side-menu toggle
